title: Gaban
desc: An unemployed son of an honest clerk tries to use his charm to con his way to a better life.

title: Lal Badshah
desc: A man who got separated from his biological parents at birth, grows up to become the voice of the people. His caring nature for others, eventually leads him on a dangerous journey to uncover the truth about who his real parents are.

title: Rootha Na Karo
desc: Naina is in love with Sudhir and is disheartened when she learns he is in love with her cousin, Neeta. She attempts to separate them by creating misunderstandings between them.

title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.
